correctness.rationale: For each mismatched truncated branching coordinate the existential equidistant t-set formula uses t at most k variables. For matched vectors, the explicit symmetric extension lemma matches every leaf at distances to at most k-1 retained leaves by following represented children or an available unused child. Induction on distance level establishes the lemma including equality and repeated selections. Maintaining this invariant in every k-pebble round proves unrestricted FO^k-equivalence. The theory count, sharp representative and least separating width are exact arithmetic consequences; counting annuli reconstruct all branch degrees. Replay checks over 21 small structures, 210 pair-width comparisons and 120068 extension configurations corroborated the critical lemma; finite tests are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A finite homogeneous ultrametric is naturally determined by its ball branching sequence; how much of that hierarchy survives a fixed logical variable budget is a motivated classification question. The theorem simultaneously determines the complete theory quotient for all h and k, the sharp smallest realization of every theory, the minimum separating width of any two structures, and the exact collapse versus full recovery by two-variable counting logic. This is a natural invariant-classification result, not an arbitrary small finite census.
